### [dbreunig/nesformer](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/30/nesformer/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-10-30

Drew Breunig built nesformer, embedding a functional Nintendo Entertainment System 6502 CPU emulator directly into the weights of Qwen3.5-4B.

- Inspired by Divyansh Agrawal's qwenputer project, the emulator bakes CPU and RAM emulation into model weights.
- The system was developed using Claude Opus 5.5 prompts to research FPGA-style emulation approaches.
- Opus 5.5 utilized a 15-year-old NES CPU conformance test suite created by Christopher Pow to validate the implementation.
- The implementation includes a CLI to load NES ROMs (such as Super Mario Bros), though execution speed remains significantly below original hardware clock speeds.

**Why it matters:** It demonstrates that autoregressive large language models can be instructed to directly execute deterministic, low-level hardware state machines and instruction sets within their weights.

`llms` `qwen` `emulation` `hardware` `generative-ai`

### [GitHub Octoverse 2026](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Oct/28/github-octoverse-2026/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-10-28

GitHub's 2026 Octoverse report reveals massive growth driven by agentic engineering, with monthly merged pull requests tripling to 220 million and monthly commits exceeding 7.38 billion.

- Monthly merged pull requests tripled to 220 million, while monthly commits more than tripled to 7.38 billion, primarily surging in H2 2026.
- The rate of new repository creation doubled year-over-year to 30.3 million per month.
- GitHub utilized LLM classification on profile locations to correct for VPN bias when tracking top countries by public repository pushes.
- Repositories created from 2022 to 2026 were categorized into NAICS industry sectors using a fine-tuned multilingual embedding model that evaluated repository metadata and README files.

**Why it matters:** The dramatic surge in commits, pull requests, and new repositories demonstrates the large-scale operational adoption and impact of automated agentic engineering tools across GitHub.
